description: Get the optimal next question for a conversational eligibility check. Call with empty field_values for the first question, then add answers and call again until decision is reached. When the ruleset author attached notes to a question (e.g. why it is asked, or legal background), they are surfaced under a Notes block.

field_values.description: Answers collected so far (empty dict for first question)

ruleset_id.description: The ID of the published rule ruleset
